premise.claim: The Helm chart shipped the pre-gate webhook configuration, so Helm installs had no v1alpha1 deprecation warning plane (and no Exact-match v1alpha1 enforcement entries) even though #524 merged the handlers and the kubectl-rendered config/webhook/manifests.yaml.
premise.evidence: results/premise-base-chart.out (round 1) and results/reverify-round2-premise.out (round 2, RBGS_HELM_SUITE_MODE=premise against the base chart): v1alpha1 InstanceSet write admitted with NO deprecation warning; v1alpha1 RBG new deprecated use rejected via the Equivalent-matching v1alpha2 gate with NO warning. Reproduce: bash scripts/run-premise-base.sh

unit.cmd: KC="$(mktemp)"; printf 'apiVersion: v1\nkind: Config\n' > "$KC"; chmod 600 "$KC"; KUBECONFIG="$KC" go test ./test/chart/ ./api/workloads/v1alpha1/ -count=1 -json; rc=$?; rm -f "$KC"; exit $rc

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$([ -x "$PWD/bin/setup-envtest" ] && "$PWD/bin/setup-envtest" use 1.31.0 --bin-dir "$PWD/bin" -p path 2>/dev/null || echo "$PWD/bin/k8s/1.31.0-linux-amd64")" go test ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1helm/ -count=1 -json

findings.note: The rendered chart's v1alpha1 deprecation webhook entries match config/webhook/manifests.yaml (name/path/rules/failurePolicy/matchPolicy/sideEffects/admissionReviewVersions). Round 2: the surface is now exactly three entries (two Fail enforcement + one merged Ignore warning entry covering the four warning-only kinds in a single rule); the test also pins the retired per-kind names as absent. Bites on base (base chart ships none) and on the round-1 six-entry shape.

Round 2 (new): the merged v1alpha1WarningHandler allows every request and returns the shared v1alpha1DeprecationWarning without decoding the object; the text still names the 0.10.0 removal. api/workloads/v1alpha1/deprecation_webhook_merged_verify_test.go.

envtest installs the CHART-RENDERED webhook configurations against production handlers: new-use rejection (explicit and schema-defaulted), type-exact grandfathering of a seeded pre-gate object, per-kind on-the-wire warnings for all four warning-only kinds through the merged endpoint, Exact match policy (no v1alpha2 warnings), ungated deletes. Round 2: registration mirrors cmd/rbgs via SetupV1alpha1WarningWebhook.

Round 2 (new): the chart README's documented inventory command (kubectl get rbg,rbgs -A -o json | jq ...) is executed verbatim against envtest with a seeded deprecated RBG, a seeded deprecated RBGSet, and a modern RoleInstanceSet control. Asserts discovery preferredVersion == v1alpha2 (the version assumption behind the documented jq paths) and that both deprecated objects and only they are listed. Same ginkgo test binary as A-GATE (specs live in docs_inventory_test.go).

F1 tracker: every v1alpha1 deprecation path the chart renders must be registered by the binary at the default image pin (values.yaml controller.image.tag -> commit). RED while the pin predates the gate (round 2: pin v0.9.0-d88b3186 serves neither the two Fail paths nor the merged Ignore path). GREEN on base (vacuous: base chart ships no v1alpha1 deprecation entries).

liveNote: L3 (skipped in this debate round): on a real cluster, helm upgrade from the pre-#552 chart to the head chart and observe (a) the transient fail-closed window for v1alpha1 RBG/RBGSet writes while old pods still serve the webhook service, (b) warnings on v1alpha1 writes once the new controller is ready.
